name: phalanx-hyperframes-sandbox
description: Local sandbox for evaluating HeyGen HyperFrames (HTML -> video) for the Phalanx launch video

scripts.lint:smoke: cd smoke && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes lint
scripts.render:smoke: cd smoke && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes render --quality high --output ../out/smoke.mp4
scripts.render:screens: cd screen-pattern && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes render --quality high --output ../out/screen-pattern.mp4
scripts.snapshot:screens: cd screen-pattern && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes snapshot --at 1.2,2.5,3.1,4.5,5.3,7.5,9.5 --no-end --output ../out/snap-screen
scripts.render:iframe: cd iframe-pattern && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes render --output ../out/iframe-test.mp4
scripts.render:perf: cd perf && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes render --no-experimental-fast-capture --quality high --output ../out/perf60.mp4
scripts.render:overlay-webm: cd alpha-overlay && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes render --format webm --output ../out/lt.webm
scripts.render:overlay-mov: cd alpha-overlay && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes render --format mov --output ../out/lt.mov
